content: Bagging and per-example out-of-bag prediction. A training dataset with distinct sample tokens includes one rose-marked query sample. It supplies THREE separate bootstrap datasets: first omits the rose query token, second includes the rose query token (possibly duplicated), third omits the rose query token. Each bootstrap trains exactly its own decision-tree learner. At prediction time the query sample connects to the learners. Only learner ONE and THREE outputs go to the OOB combiner. Learner TWO does NOT connect to OOB combiner; a clear inactive/skipped path or no path. Visually show repeated sampled tokens and omissions rather than abstract identical cards. Use a visually distinct dataset membership lane and prediction lane, labels will clarify excluded-training condition. Original composition, exactly three members, data relationships must be unambiguous.
prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL academic machine-learning mechanism diagram; choose a fresh composition yourself. External reference images are used ONLY to understand the relevant mechanism, NOT to copy their layout, typography, gradients or colors. Output entirely UNLABELLED PNG with transparent canvas. Draw NO text, letters, numerals, mathematical glyphs, pseudo text, watermark. Reserve clear label slots next to real mechanism objects and within empty processing nodes; leave roomy margins for actual Chinese labels later. Flat 2D technical illustration: thin neutral #4C4D4F connections, simple filled arrowheads with exact endpoints, no lines crossing unrelated nodes. White/open regions plus a FEW pale solid grouping regions, never a grid of decorative cards. Repeated same-semantic nodes use the same color and omit decorative icons consistently. Necessary tensors, sample tokens, trees, split diagrams are mechanism objects. Palette #7B95C6 blue, #49C2D9 cyan, #67A583 green, #F59C7C orange, #C85E62 rose, pale uniform 18–30% white-mixed tints. Every colored continuous shape has constant flat color. NO gradient, paper/canvas texture, wave, grain, clouding, stripes, gloss, shadows, halos, glow, 3D, perspective. Exactly follow dependencies described below, do not invent relations merely for symmetry.

generation_versions.prompt:
Style: exact white opaque canvas; flat 2D technical drawing, no gradients, textures, shadows, pseudo text, numbers or letters. Rounded rectangle modules (6 px corner radius), neutral dark wires #556170. Blue priority #7188A3 with fill #E5EAF0 for the main mechanism; muted green #829C8B fill #E8EEE9 only secondary sources; muted yellow #B4A16F fill #F1ECDD for position/selection; muted red #A7787D fill #F0E5E6 only losses/errors, not the generic output; purple #9588A5 only a further category if needed. Most area white, fills pale and uniform. Draw all shapes, actual mechanism glyphs, matrices and connectors, leave labels empty for real-font typography.
Precise palette/corner edit of reference1 ONLY: ensemble-bagging-oob. Preserve EXACT canvas 1536x1024, every module footprint, connector bend, arrow direction, number of objects/cells, sample and function glyphs. Do not rearrange or invent any detail. Replace vivid cyan/blue with muted BLUE, pale backgrounds; primary computational modules BLUE, secondary sources GREEN sparingly, position/selection/alternate third class YELLOW; generic outputs BLUE not red. RED only actual gradient/loss/error/exclusion, PURPLE only fourth/fifth semantic category. Distinct categorical colors preserve distinct categories in priority BLUE GREEN YELLOW RED PURPLE. Make ordinary rectangular modules rounded while matrix cells, data bars, tensor planes, samples and scientific factor symbols retain geometry. Flat fills no noise or glow. Images of samples/neuron anatomy/function traces are scientific content: preserve their geometry and values, retain natural sample colors. NO letters/digits/operators added; spaces are intentionally reserved for true fonts. Reference2 is style context only, do not add its objects.
